notes.title: Version 1.0.13
notes.notes:
Updated Ren'Py engine to version 8.2.2
 Updated image caching limits to take advantage of higher minimum specs and use more RAM when available for improved image prediction, especially in the game's CG gallery. As a result, the game should perform better when loading large images and respond to some player actions faster.
 Reworked the time display in the save/load UI to better fit regional time-telling formats for each language. (adding the year, alternating 12-hour and 24-hour times, re-ordering elements, etc.)
 Updated some UI text to improve the text-to-speech accessibility mode. (English only)

notes.title: Version 1.0.12
notes.notes:
Updated Ren'Py engine to version 8.2.0
 Implemented Ren'Py "Deferred Translation Loading", which should significantly reduce loading times and slightly improve in-game performance.

notes.title: Version 1.0.10
notes.notes:
Finished Polish language translation.
 Adjusted code for language setting on game startup. The game should automatically adjust to your chosen language in the Steam UI again.
 Updated Ren'Py engine to version 8.1.2

notes.title: Version 1.0.9
notes.notes:
Added translations for a yes/no prompt added in Ren'Py 8.1.0.
 Adjusted website links in Extras menus.

notes.title: Version 1.0.8 (release build)
notes.notes:
This will be the final patch before release, and the one that is available on launch day.

 Character voice volume adjustments for balancing
 Some progress on the Polish translation
 Typo fixes and text adjustments to fit the voice acting. For what should be the final time, hopefully.

notes.title: Release date!
notes.notes:
After a long period of development, I'm finally at a point where I feel like I can announce a release date, and not have to dance around with estimates or potential delays. THank you to everyone for your patience!

Slimy Sextet will release on Steam on May 19th at 6pm PST.

I am still going to push minor patches before launch, and I can't guarantee that I will have all languages fully translated by then, but I feel fairly certain that I will have all of the most important languages supported at that point, and the game will be just about as polished as I can possibly make it otherwise.

I'm excited to share the full game in its final form with everyone, and I hope you'll all enjoy it!
